senses.en: An organism with a changed gene.

ex.en: Mutant flies were used to study development.
ex.zh: 研究者用突变果蝇研究发育。

senses.en: The breeding of two different species or varieties.

ex.en: Hybridization produced hardier wheat.
ex.zh: 杂交培育出更耐寒的小麦。

senses.en: Making a genetically identical copy of an organism or cell.

ex.en: Cloning raised many ethical questions.
ex.zh: 克隆引发了许多伦理问题。

senses.en: Until now or until the time being discussed.

ex.en: The repair revealed a hitherto hidden cupboard upstairs.
ex.zh: 这次维修让楼上一个此前一直隐藏着的壁橱显露了出来。

ex.en: Recent archaeological discoveries have revealed hitherto unknown details about trade between ancient coastal communities.
ex.zh: 近期的考古发现揭示了此前未知的古代沿海社区间贸易的细节。

tip: 正式用语，常见于hitherto unknown等搭配。

senses.en: A genetically identical copy of an organism; to make one.

ex.en: Dolly the sheep was the first cloned mammal.
ex.zh: 多利羊是第一只克隆哺乳动物。

senses.en: Containing genes from another species.

ex.en: Transgenic crops can resist certain insects.
ex.zh: 转基因作物能抵抗某些害虫。

senses.en: Made by combining DNA from different sources.

ex.en: Insulin is now made with recombinant DNA.
ex.zh: 胰岛素现在用重组DNA技术生产。

senses.en: A small ring of DNA in bacteria, used to move genes.

ex.en: Scientists insert genes into plasmids.
ex.zh: 科学家把基因插入质粒。

senses.en: Mentioned or presented earlier in a piece of writing.

ex.en: The foregoing advice helped me fix my bike.
ex.zh: 前面提到的建议帮我修好了自行车。

ex.en: The foregoing analysis suggests that investment in early education can reduce social inequality over time.
ex.zh: 上述分析表明，对早期教育的投资能逐步减少社会不平等。

tip: 正式书面语，常用the foregoing修饰名词。

senses.en: The substance an enzyme acts on; the surface something grows on.

ex.en: Each enzyme fits only one kind of substrate.
ex.zh: 每种酶只适合一种底物。

senses.en: A short chain of amino acids.

ex.en: Some hormones are small peptides.
ex.zh: 有些激素是小分子肽。

senses.en: A fat or oil-like substance in living things.

ex.en: Cell membranes are made largely of lipids.
ex.zh: 细胞膜主要由脂质构成。

senses.en: to pay out money, especially from an official fund

ex.en: The charity will disburse the funds early next week.
ex.zh: 这家慈善机构将在下周初拨付这笔资金。

ex.en: Governments should disburse emergency funds quickly to help communities recover from natural disasters.
ex.zh: 政府应迅速拨付应急资金，帮助社区从自然灾害中恢复。

tip: 正式用词，常以funds或money作宾语。

senses.en: A simple sugar that is a main source of energy for cells.

ex.en: Plants make glucose by photosynthesis.
ex.zh: 植物通过光合作用制造葡萄糖。

senses.en: A form of stored sugar in animals' liver and muscles.

ex.en: Athletes build up glycogen before a race.
ex.zh: 运动员在比赛前储存糖原。

senses.en: The part of a plant cell where photosynthesis happens.

ex.en: Chloroplasts contain green chlorophyll.
ex.zh: 叶绿体含有绿色的叶绿素。

senses.en: Parts of a cell that produce energy.

ex.en: Muscle cells contain many mitochondria.
ex.zh: 肌肉细胞含有许多线粒体。

senses.en: A strong public reaction of anger or excitement.

ex.en: The sudden closure of the playground caused a furor.
ex.zh: 游乐场突然关闭，引起了强烈不满。

ex.en: The proposed increase in university fees sparked a furor among students and their families.
ex.zh: 拟议中的大学学费上涨引发了学生及其家庭的强烈不满。

col: cause a furor｜引起轩然大波
a furor over something｜因某事引发的风波
tip: 美式常用furor，英式常用furore；多指公众强烈反应。

senses.en: A tiny structure in a cell where proteins are made.

ex.en: Ribosomes read genetic instructions to build proteins.
ex.zh: 核糖体读取遗传指令来合成蛋白质。

senses.en: One of the basic units that make up DNA and RNA.

ex.en: DNA is a long chain of nucleotides.
ex.zh: DNA是一条长长的核苷酸链。

senses.en: The jelly-like material inside a cell, outside the nucleus.

ex.en: Many chemical reactions take place in the cytoplasm.
ex.zh: 许多化学反应在细胞质中进行。

senses.en: A structure inside a cell with a specific job.

ex.en: The nucleus is the largest organelle.
ex.zh: 细胞核是最大的细胞器。

senses.en: to pay all or part of a cost

ex.en: The club helped defray the cost of my trip.
ex.zh: 俱乐部帮我支付了部分旅行费用。

ex.en: Universities could offer additional grants to defray accommodation expenses for students from low-income households.
ex.zh: 大学可以提供额外补助，帮助低收入家庭的学生支付住宿费用。

tip: 正式用词，宾语通常是costs或expenses，不是人。

senses.en: A space in a cell filled with fluid.

ex.en: Plant cells have a large central vacuole.
ex.zh: 植物细胞有一个大的中央液泡。

senses.en: A network of fibers that gives a cell its shape.

ex.en: The cytoskeleton helps the cell move.
ex.zh: 细胞骨架帮助细胞运动。

senses.en: A single-celled organism without a nucleus, such as a bacterium.

ex.en: Prokaryotes were the first life on Earth.
ex.zh: 原核生物是地球上最早的生命。

senses.en: To excite desire for something that remains out of reach.

ex.en: The smell of fresh bread tantalized us outside the bakery.
ex.zh: 面包店外，新鲜面包的香气馋得我们直流口水。

ex.en: Early discoveries tantalize researchers with the possibility of finding affordable treatments for currently incurable diseases.
ex.zh: 早期发现让研究人员对找到价格可负担的疗法、治疗目前尚无法治愈的疾病充满期待。

col: tantalize someone with｜用某物引逗某人
tantalizing glimpse｜勾起渴望的短暂一瞥
tantalizing prospect｜诱人却未实现的前景
tip: 英式也写tantalise；强调勾起欲望却暂时得不到。

senses.en: An organism whose cells have a nucleus.

ex.en: Plants, animals and fungi are eukaryotes.
ex.zh: 植物、动物和真菌都是真核生物。

senses.en: Relating to cells without a nucleus.

ex.en: Prokaryotic cells are much smaller than ours.
ex.zh: 原核细胞比我们的细胞小得多。

senses.en: Relating to cells with a nucleus.

ex.en: Eukaryotic cells contain many organelles.
ex.zh: 真核细胞含有许多细胞器。

senses.en: Relating to very small living things such as bacteria.

ex.en: Microbial life thrives in the soil.
ex.zh: 土壤中微生物生命繁盛。

senses.en: express a financial amount in a particular currency
give a particular name to something

ex.en: The bank denominated our overseas loan in euros.
ex.zh: 银行将我们的海外贷款以欧元计价。

ex.en: Loans denominated in foreign currencies can become more expensive when the domestic currency loses value.
ex.zh: 本国货币贬值时，以外币计价的贷款可能变得更加昂贵。

tip: 金融中常用be denominated in＋货币；命名义较罕见。

senses.en: A microorganism that causes disease.

ex.en: The pathogen spreads through contaminated water.
ex.zh: 这种病原体通过受污染的水传播。

senses.en: Able to cause disease.

ex.en: Most bacteria are not pathogenic.
ex.zh: 大多数细菌不致病。

senses.en: A substance that causes the body to produce antibodies.

ex.en: Vaccines expose the body to a harmless antigen.
ex.zh: 疫苗让身体接触无害的抗原。

senses.en: a star that explodes and becomes extremely bright

ex.en: Astronomers spotted a supernova.
ex.zh: 天文学家发现了一颗超新星。

ex.en: Many heavy elements, including the iron in our blood, were created in supernova explosions.
ex.zh: 许多重元素，包括我们血液中的铁，都是在超新星爆发中产生的。

tip: 天文讲座常见。

senses.en: Giving someone a vaccine to protect against disease.

ex.en: Inoculation against smallpox began in the 1700s.
ex.zh: 天花接种始于18世纪。

senses.en: A type of white blood cell that fights infection.

ex.en: Lymphocytes recognize invading germs.
ex.zh: 淋巴细胞能识别入侵的病菌。

senses.en: A white blood cell.

ex.en: Leukocytes increase during infection.
ex.zh: 感染时白细胞会增加。

senses.en: The protein in red blood cells that carries oxygen.

ex.en: Hemoglobin gives blood its red color.
ex.zh: 血红蛋白使血液呈红色。

senses.en: to spread throughout a place or affect every part

ex.en: The smell of fresh bread pervaded the kitchen.
ex.zh: 新鲜面包的香味弥漫了整个厨房。

ex.en: Digital technology now pervades everyday life, changing how people communicate, study, and access public services.
ex.zh: 数字技术如今渗透日常生活，改变着人们交流、学习和获取公共服务的方式。

col: pervade the atmosphere｜弥漫在气氛中
a sense of unease pervades｜不安感弥漫
tip: 及物动词，直接接场所或领域，不加介词。

senses.en: A small blood cell that helps blood to clot.

ex.en: Platelets stop bleeding from small cuts.
ex.zh: 血小板能止住小伤口的出血。

senses.en: Relating to the movement of blood around the body.

ex.en: The heart is the center of the circulatory system.
ex.zh: 心脏是循环系统的中心。

senses.en: Relating to breathing.

ex.en: Smoking causes respiratory diseases.
ex.zh: 吸烟会引起呼吸系统疾病。

senses.en: Able to be hammered or pressed into a different shape.
Easily influenced or changed by other people or circumstances.

ex.en: The warm metal was malleable enough to bend easily.
ex.zh: 这块温热的金属可塑性足够好，很容易弯曲。

ex.en: Young people's attitudes are often malleable, making schools important environments for developing respect and social responsibility.
ex.zh: 年轻人的态度往往具有可塑性，因此学校是培养尊重意识与社会责任感的重要环境。

tip: 金属义强调锻压成形；ductile强调可拉成丝。

senses.en: Relating to glands that release hormones into the blood.

ex.en: The thyroid is part of the endocrine system.
ex.zh: 甲状腺是内分泌系统的一部分。

senses.en: Relating to the skeleton; very thin.

ex.en: Skeletal muscles move the bones.
ex.zh: 骨骼肌带动骨骼运动。

senses.en: Relating to mammals.

ex.en: The mammalian heart has four chambers.
ex.zh: 哺乳动物的心脏有四个腔。

senses.en: An animal with a hard outer shell and jointed legs, such as an insect or crab.

ex.en: Arthropods make up most animal species.
ex.zh: 节肢动物占动物物种的大多数。

senses.en: The degree to which something can be sold easily.

ex.en: Fresh paint improved the salability of our old house.
ex.zh: 重新刷漆让我们的旧房子更容易卖出。

ex.en: Manufacturers often adjust packaging to improve the salability of products in highly competitive markets.
ex.zh: 制造商经常调整包装，以提高产品在竞争激烈市场中的适销性。

tip: 美式拼写；英式通常写作saleability。

senses.en: A soft-bodied animal, often with a shell, such as a snail or octopus.

ex.en: Octopuses are clever mollusks.
ex.zh: 章鱼是聪明的软体动物。

senses.en: A complete change of form, such as a caterpillar becoming a butterfly.

ex.en: Frogs undergo metamorphosis from tadpoles.
ex.zh: 青蛙从蝌蚪经过变态发育而来。

senses.en: The hard case in which a caterpillar changes into a butterfly.

ex.en: The butterfly emerged from its chrysalis.
ex.zh: 蝴蝶从蛹中钻了出来。

senses.en: News reporting, especially detailed accounts based on direct observation

ex.en: Her vivid reportage brought the remote village to life.
ex.zh: 她生动的报道让那个偏远村庄跃然眼前。

ex.en: Independent reportage can reveal environmental damage that might otherwise escape public attention and government scrutiny.
ex.zh: 独立报道可以揭露那些原本可能逃过公众关注和政府审查的环境破坏。

tip: 通常不可数，比reporting正式，常强调现场记录。

senses.en: A silk covering that some insects make to protect themselves while changing form.

ex.en: Silkworms spin cocoons of fine thread.
ex.zh: 蚕吐出细丝结茧。

senses.en: A young insect that looks like a small adult; a spirit in myths.

ex.en: Dragonfly nymphs live underwater.
ex.zh: 蜻蜓的若虫生活在水下。

senses.en: Shedding old feathers, skin or shell to make way for new growth.

ex.en: Crabs are soft and vulnerable after molting.
ex.zh: 螃蟹蜕壳后身体柔软、容易受伤。

senses.en: A hard outer covering that supports and protects an animal's body.

ex.en: Insects have an exoskeleton made of chitin.
ex.zh: 昆虫有几丁质构成的外骨骼。

senses.en: Overused and therefore no longer interesting or original

ex.en: The film ends with a trite speech about friendship.
ex.zh: 影片以一段关于友谊的老套演说结束。

ex.en: Public awareness campaigns may fail when they rely on trite slogans rather than practical advice and convincing evidence.
ex.zh: 公众宣传活动如果依赖老套的口号，而非实用建议和有说服力的证据，就可能失败。

tip: 强调因反复使用而失去新意，不只是年代久远。

senses.en: A skeleton inside the body.

ex.en: Vertebrates have an endoskeleton of bone.
ex.zh: 脊椎动物有骨质内骨骼。

senses.en: A strong band of tissue that connects a muscle to a bone.

ex.en: She injured a tendon in her ankle.
ex.zh: 她脚踝的一条肌腱受了伤。

senses.en: A strong band of tissue that connects bones at a joint.

ex.en: The footballer tore a knee ligament.
ex.zh: 这名足球运动员膝盖韧带撕裂。

senses.en: A mammal whose young develop in a pouch, such as a kangaroo.

ex.en: Most marsupials live in Australia.
ex.zh: 大多数有袋动物生活在澳大利亚。

senses.en: The everyday language spoken by people in a particular place.

senses.zh: 本地语言的；本土风格的
senses.en: Using local everyday language or traditional local building styles.

ex.en: Our guide chatted with market traders in the local vernacular.
ex.zh: 导游用当地话与市场里的商贩闲聊。

ex.en: Teaching in the vernacular can help young children understand lessons while maintaining connections with their cultural heritage.
ex.zh: 用本地语言教学能帮助幼童理解课程，同时保持与自身文化传统的联系。

col: the local vernacular｜当地日常用语
tip: 强调当地日常语言，不等同于“本国的”。

senses.en: Relating to mammals whose young develop inside the mother with a placenta.

ex.en: Humans are placental mammals.
ex.zh: 人类是有胎盘哺乳动物。

senses.en: An animal that eats both plants and meat.

ex.en: Bears are omnivores.
ex.zh: 熊是杂食动物。

senses.en: An animal's resemblance to another species or object for protection.

ex.en: Through mimicry, a harmless fly looks like a wasp.
ex.zh: 通过拟态，一种无害的苍蝇看起来像黄蜂。

senses.en: To make someone feel excited, energetic, and very happy

ex.en: The fast boat ride exhilarated everyone on board.
ex.zh: 快艇飞驰让船上的每个人都兴奋不已。

ex.en: Outdoor adventures can exhilarate participants while helping them develop confidence and a stronger connection with nature.
ex.zh: 户外探险能让参与者精神振奋，同时帮助他们增强自信，加深与自然的联系。

col: exhilarated by the experience｜因这次经历而振奋
an exhilarating experience｜令人兴奋的经历
tip: 及物动词；人感到兴奋用exhilarated。

senses.en: Living on or in another organism and taking food from it.

ex.en: Parasitic worms can live in the gut.
ex.zh: 寄生虫可以生活在肠道中。

senses.en: The science of naming and classifying living things.

ex.en: Linnaeus founded modern taxonomy.
ex.zh: 林奈创立了现代分类学。

senses.en: A major group in the classification of living things, below kingdom.

ex.en: All vertebrates belong to the phylum Chordata.
ex.zh: 所有脊椎动物都属于脊索动物门。

senses.en: A group within a species that differs slightly, often by region.

ex.en: The Siberian tiger is a subspecies of tiger.
ex.zh: 东北虎是虎的一个亚种。

senses.en: so small that it is almost impossible to measure
a mathematical quantity smaller in magnitude than any positive real number

ex.en: The scratch made an infinitesimal difference to the table's appearance.
ex.zh: 这道划痕对桌子外观的影响微乎其微。

ex.en: Even infinitesimal changes in ocean temperature can become significant when measured across vast areas over decades.
ex.zh: 即使海水温度变化极其微小，若在广阔海域持续数十年，也可能产生显著影响。

tip: 比small语气强得多；名词用法主要见于数学。

senses.en: The formation of new species during evolution.

ex.en: Isolation on islands can lead to speciation.
ex.zh: 岛屿上的隔离可能导致物种形成。

senses.en: The line of ancestors from which a person or species descends.

ex.en: The lineage of whales goes back to land animals.
ex.zh: 鲸的谱系可追溯到陆地动物。

senses.en: Remaining as a small, useless trace of something once important.

ex.en: The human appendix may be a vestigial organ.
ex.zh: 人类的阑尾可能是退化器官。

senses.en: Relating to the separate parts that make up a whole

ex.en: Our tutor used componential analysis to compare similar words.
ex.zh: 我们的老师用成分分析法比较近义词。

ex.en: In linguistics, componential analysis examines word meanings by breaking them down into smaller, shared semantic features.
ex.zh: 在语言学中，成分分析通过将词义分解为较小的共有语义特征来研究词义。

tip: 专业形容词，常见于语言学术语componential analysis。

senses.en: Having a similar structure because of a shared ancestor.

ex.en: A bat's wing and a human arm are homologous.
ex.zh: 蝙蝠的翅膀和人的手臂是同源器官。

senses.en: Becoming similar or coming together.

ex.en: Sharks and dolphins show convergent evolution.
ex.zh: 鲨鱼和海豚表现出趋同进化。

senses.en: Developing in different directions.

ex.en: Island birds took divergent paths.
ex.zh: 岛上的鸟类走上了不同的进化道路。

senses.en: The evolutionary history of a species or group.

ex.en: DNA has reshaped our view of bird phylogeny.
ex.zh: DNA改变了我们对鸟类系统发育的认识。

senses.en: thick and sticky, flowing slowly

ex.en: Honey is more viscous than water.
ex.zh: 蜂蜜比水黏稠。

ex.en: Volcanoes with viscous lava tend to erupt explosively because gas cannot escape easily.
ex.zh: 熔岩黏稠的火山往往爆炸式喷发，因为气体不易逸出。

tip: 火山喷发类型话题常见。

senses.en: Relating to the evolutionary relationships between organisms.

ex.en: A phylogenetic tree shows how species are related.
ex.zh: 系统发生树显示物种之间的关系。

senses.en: A method of classifying organisms by shared features from common ancestors.

ex.en: Cladistics groups birds with dinosaurs.
ex.zh: 分支系统学把鸟类和恐龙归为一类。

senses.en: Breathing; the process by which cells release energy from food.

ex.en: Cellular respiration releases carbon dioxide.
ex.zh: 细胞呼吸会释放二氧化碳。

senses.en: previously mentioned in the same document or statement

ex.en: The contract says we must pay the aforesaid fee.
ex.zh: 合同规定我们必须支付上述费用。

ex.en: The aforesaid conditions must be satisfied before the council can approve any construction within the protected area.
ex.zh: 必须满足上述条件，地方议会才能批准保护区内的任何建设项目。

tip: 法律或正式书面语，通常置于名词前。

senses.en: The loss of water vapor from plant leaves.

ex.en: Transpiration pulls water up from the roots.
ex.zh: 蒸腾作用把水分从根部拉上来。

senses.en: The process of a seed beginning to grow.

ex.en: Warmth and water trigger germination.
ex.zh: 温暖和水分促使种子发芽。

senses.en: An animal that carries pollen from one flower to another.

ex.en: Bees are the most important pollinators.
ex.zh: 蜜蜂是最重要的传粉者。

senses.en: The male part of a flower that produces pollen.

ex.en: Each stamen holds a pollen sac.
ex.zh: 每根雄蕊都有一个花粉囊。

senses.en: Showing disrespect for religion, or using offensive language.
To treat something sacred with serious disrespect.

ex.en: The coach apologised for his profane language after the match.
ex.zh: 教练为赛后说的粗话道了歉。

ex.en: Museums should explain why objects considered ordinary by outsiders may be sacred, making careless treatment seem profane.
ex.zh: 博物馆应解释为何外人眼中的普通物品可能是神圣之物，以致随意对待会显得亵渎。

col: profane a sacred place｜亵渎圣地
tip: 形容词常修饰language；动词指亵渎神圣事物。

senses.en: The female part of a flower.

ex.en: Pollen lands on the top of the pistil.
ex.zh: 花粉落在雌蕊的顶端。

senses.en: The organ that produces eggs; in plants, the part that holds the seeds.

ex.en: The ovary of a flower develops into a fruit.
ex.zh: 花的子房会发育成果实。

senses.en: The network of thread-like parts of a fungus.

ex.en: Mycelium spreads underground for meters.
ex.zh: 菌丝体在地下蔓延数米。

senses.en: The larger front bone between the knee and ankle

ex.en: The doctor showed me my tibia on the scan.
ex.zh: 医生在扫描影像上指给我看我的胫骨。

ex.en: A fracture of the tibia may require several months of rehabilitation before an athlete can safely resume training.
ex.zh: 胫骨骨折可能需要数月康复，运动员才能安全恢复训练。

col: the tibia and fibula｜胫骨和腓骨
tip: 即shinbone；复数可用tibias或tibiae。

senses.en: A plant-like organism made of a fungus and an alga living together.

ex.en: Lichens grow on bare rock.
ex.zh: 地衣生长在光秃秃的岩石上。

senses.en: A plant with feathery leaves that reproduces by spores.

ex.en: Ferns covered the forest floor.
ex.zh: 蕨类植物覆盖着林地。

senses.en: A plant whose seeds are not enclosed in a fruit, such as a pine.

ex.en: Conifers are the best-known gymnosperms.
ex.zh: 针叶树是最著名的裸子植物。

senses.en: A flowering plant whose seeds are enclosed in a fruit.

ex.en: Angiosperms spread rapidly in the Cretaceous.
ex.zh: 被子植物在白垩纪迅速扩张。

senses.en: Expressing very strong feelings, especially anger or opposition

ex.en: Her vehement refusal surprised everyone at the table.
ex.zh: 她激烈的拒绝让桌旁的每个人都很惊讶。

ex.en: The proposed closure of the community library met with vehement opposition from residents and local educators.
ex.zh: 关闭社区图书馆的提议遭到了居民和当地教育工作者的强烈反对。

tip: 多形容反对、否认或批评的强烈程度，语气较正式。
